Four of the 10 lines have no safe option right now: RM-005, RM-008, RM-009 and RM-010. I counted an option as safe only if it cleared the questionnaire, is comparable, has no risk flags and is not late. All five vendors have replied. The other six lines each have at least one safe option.

- RM-005 (Caffeine): There are two quotes and neither is safe.
  - V02 cleared the questionnaire, but its claim was contradicted and it withheld information.
  - V05 failed the knockout "No COA before order". It is also not comparable, and its flags say it needs an MOQ in kg and has not enough data.
- RM-008 (Rosemary extract): There are three quotes and none is safe.
  - V03 cleared the questionnaire, but it carries MOQ_COVER and STRENGTH_ADJUSTED flags.
  - V04 cleared the questionnaire, but it is 22 days late and is also flagged STRENGTH_ADJUSTED.
  - V05 failed the "No COA before order" knockout. It also has MOQ_SHELF and REMAINING_ASSUMED flags.
- RM-009 (Copper tripeptide): There are two quotes and neither is safe.
  - V02 failed the knockouts "Cold chain not validated" and "Shelf life below minimum". It also has contradicted-claim and withheld flags.
  - V04 cleared the questionnaire, but it is 36 days late. It also has COA_CONFLICT, MOQ_COVER and SPACE_CLASH flags.
- RM-010 (Acetyl tetrapeptide): There are two quotes and neither is safe.
  - V02 failed the same two knockouts as on RM-009 and has the same flags.
  - V04 cleared the questionnaire, but it is 36 days late. It also has MOQ_COVER and SPACE_CLASH flags.

V04's lateness is the main timing risk. The first need-by date is 20 December 2026, and I haven't checked what these delays mean against it.

I did not check OTIF or defect history for this question.
